changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ScoreItemLink') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink]( [ScoreUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ScoreItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricScoreItemLink] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ScoreUid] ASC, [ScoreItemUid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore] FOREIGN KEY([ScoreUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[Score] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem] FOREIGN KEY([ScoreItemUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[ScoreItem] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem] END
